project_scope.topic_angle: 夏の台所まわりで見直したい安全チェック
project_scope.topic_angle_en: Summer kitchen safety checks every senior should review
project_scope.viewer_problem: Japanese senior viewers living alone want practical guidance on keeping their kitchen safe during hot summer months — covering food storage, ventilation, fire risk, and hygiene habits.

special_notes: focus on summer kitchen safety: food spoilage prevention, ventilation while cooking, fire and gas awareness, hygiene in humid conditions
prefer object and environment shots over face-centric scenes — kitchen counters, refrigerator, stove area, ventilation fans
avoid disease-cure framing unless the policy gate clearly allows it
seasonal tie-in: high humidity and temperature make food safety and kitchen ventilation especially critical for seniors living alone
long-form only; do not derive shorts
